howto.name: Upload a CSV file
howto.text: Select a .csv or .tsv file up to 500 MB. The first row is treated as column headers by default.

howto.name: Customize table appearance
howto.text: Set font size, enable zebra striping, choose landscape or portrait orientation. Wide tables automatically wrap or scale to fit.

howto.name: Convert to PDF
howto.text: Click Convert. The data is rendered into a clean, paginated table in the output PDF.

faq.a: Yes. Comma, semicolon, tab, and pipe delimiters are automatically detected. You can also specify the delimiter manually.
Wide tables can be rendered in landscape orientation. If they still exceed the page width, columns are scaled to fit or split across pages.

faq.q: Is the first row treated as a header?
faq.a: By default yes — the first row is bolded as a header. You can disable this if your data has no header row.
